info.name: Wishlist API
info.description:
Postman collection for WishlistController (`/api/wishlists`).

Endpoints:
- POST /{customerId}/products/{productId} — add product (201)
- DELETE /{customerId}/products/{productId} — remove product (204)
- DELETE /{customerId} — remove wishlist (204)
- GET /{customerId}/products — list products and notes (200)
- POST /{customerId}/products/{productId}/notes — add note in body (201)

request.description:
POST /api/wishlists/{customerId}/products/{productId}/notes

Adds a note to a product already in the wishlist.
Body: plain text (`@RequestBody String note`).

Response: 201 Created (empty body).
